name: Brand note and lead email survive backward navigation
description: Client-authoritative brand details remain intact when moving backward and forward.

planSteps.description: Open a valid unused test invitation link and navigate through Business and Services using fictional valid required data
On Brand add a short brand note, set an existing brand colour, upload a logo, and enter leads@example.com
Use Back to Services, then Continue to Brand
The brand note, existing brand colour, uploaded logo preview, and lead notification email remain present
Return to Services one more time, then continue to Brand
The brand colour and lead notification email are preserved after repeated backward navigation
